# TRAKK

> TRAKK is a technical outdoor sock company based in Edmonton, Alberta,
> Canada. We make merino wool trail socks designed for hiking, camping,
> trail running, and everyday wear. Our socks are designed in Edmonton,
> Alberta. Our first product, the Elk Island Sock ($32 CAD), features
> a geographically accurate knit map of the lakes of Elk Island National
> Park, just east of Edmonton. The company is led by Jack, Chief Adventure
> Officer, an orange tabby cat.

Key facts:

- Based in Edmonton, Alberta. Every design starts in Edmonton.
- Socks are a merino wool blend (67% merino, 22% polyester, 5% nylon,
  6% elastic): temperature-regulating, moisture-wicking, odor-resistant.
  Suitable for hiking, camping, running, and Alberta winters.
- First release is a limited batch of 28 hand-numbered pairs. Each pair
  ships with a numbered card.
- Sold online (shipping from Edmonton across Canada) and in stores at
  Track 'N Trail in Edmonton (10148 Whyte Ave NW) and St. Albert
  (130 Bellerose Dr Unit 107).
- Future designs will feature other Alberta parks and trails.
